about_the_game:
Prepare for Battle: A Mob of Heroes Is About to Invade Your Domain!

Build traps in your dungeon, hire monsters, discover relics with mysterious powers, and protect your lair from the heroes who seek to overthrow you.

◆ CONTENT

  • Dark Lords with unique abilities

  • Monsters and heroes

  • Traps and rooms to customize your dungeon

  • Relics imbued with mysterious powers

  • Various events full of surprises

Numerous elements to unlock as you play

Rule as a true monarch, fill your domain with rooms, manage an unbreakable defense, and let your dungeon flourish.

◆ BUILD YOUR OWN DUNGEON

Think carefully when placing traps, rooms, and monsters into your dungeon. Strong strategy will help you survive the swarm of heroes and allow you to unlock more elements for your dungeon. May your dungeon endure the bravest heroes there are!

◆ CHOOSE YOUR FATE

Choose your fate from a selection of fate cards every day. If you wish to battle, heroes will come, and if you wish for surprises, a special event will take place.

Choose the fate you want as the master of your dungeon.

short_description: Combine unique deck-building and dungeon management in this strategic roguelike. Defend your domain with traps, monsters, and powerful relics as hordes of heroes attempt to invade. Will you rise to become the true Dark Lord of the Dungeon?
